decisive_items: CT abdomen: normal adrenal glands, 1.9 cm × 2.8 cm contrast-enhancing mass in bladder wall with surrounding lymphadenopathy
isolated elevation in plasma normetanephrine (36 nmol/L)
response.rationale: Extra-adrenal contrast-enhancing bladder mass with micturition-triggered catecholamine symptoms and isolated normetanephrine elevation indicates bladder paraganglioma; pheochromocytoma is unlikely because the adrenal glands are normal.

rejected.why: Although catecholamine excess is present, the tumor is extra-adrenal in the bladder wall with normal adrenal glands, which is more consistent with paraganglioma than pheochromocytoma.
